text:
deploy-bot: deploy queued: service=llm-router version=2.5.0; feature flag plan `llmroute_v2_toggle`: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. auto-quarantine enabled. change-window 03:00-05:00 UTC.
diana: dropping notes: release includes routing fallback, cost-improvements, and a model checksum pin. link: https://redwood-internal/release/llm-router/2.5.0
josh: setting watchers for p99, ephemerals, and token-cost. thresholds: p99>900ms or client-errors>0.5% = trigger quarantine.
qa-lead: smoke e2e passed on staging. running a targeted soak on customer-critical prompts before prod ramp.
perf-bot: baseline capture created id=cap-20260401-09. use for regressions.
release-manager: starting 2% canary now. will wait 5m then proceed to 10% if green. manual ack required at 50%.
deploy-bot: rolled 2% -> cohorts c-a. routing pinned to v=2.5.0 for cohorts.
diana: 2% looks clean. no error spikes.
josh: small token-cost variance -3%. good.
qa-lead: soak sample ok (200 requests). no structured-output diffs.
perf-bot: quick perf diff: p50 -3ms, p95 +8ms. within noise.
release-manager: ramping to 10% now.
deploy-bot: ramp -> 10%. cohorts c-a -> c-b.
diana: 10% steady. but seeing a rare null-field in JSON output for a specific prompt id=cu-771. filing repro.
qa-lead: reproducer created and added to ticket REL-882. not seen in staging.
josh: that null-field affects a downstream parser used by one enterprise customer. we should be cautious.
infra-oncall: adding a soft-quarantine rule: if customer-critical error seen on prod at >0.02% absolute for 2 holds, auto-quarantine the flag.
release-manager: hold at 10% until we triage cu-771. don't move to 50% without ack.
diana: triage shows regression tied to model tokenization when prompt contains leading emoji. weird.
josh: we can either hotfix tokenizer or do a targeted cohort exclusion for customers on the soak-list. option B faster.
qa-lead: targeted cohort exclusion would route those customer IDs off v2 via cohort override. we can enact via FF ruleset.
release-manager: decision required: full pause and hotfix (longer), or quarantine with cohort exclusion (fast, surgical). prefer surgical to avoid broad rollback.
diana: surgical plan: exclude 8 enterprise customer IDs from v2 cohorts, keep ramping to 50% for remainder. also create follow-up ticket to hotfix tokenizer.
josh: +1 for surgical. but add protective circuit: if excluded customers see degradation after change, we'll revert.
perf-bot: scheduled extra sampling for excluded customer prompts to ensure no side effects.
release-manager: approved surgical exclusion. applying FF rule now.
deploy-bot: applied FF rule: `llmroute_v2_toggle` updated -> exclude cohorts for ids [cust-102, cust-305, cust-411, cust-502, cust-618, cust-723, cust-834, cust-999]. ramp to 50% will proceed.
infra-oncall: note: cohort overrides pinned; will persist until manual removal. auto-unpin disabled for this change.
qa-lead: running quick verification on excluded IDs.
diana: excluded customer checks show they are routed to v1 as intended.
josh: proceed to 50% when ready.
release-manager: starting ramp -> 50% now with 5m holdpoints. enhanced tracing on cu-771 path.
deploy-bot: ramp -> 50% initiated. cohorts expanded.
perf-bot: at 50% p99 increased by 12ms; cost stable. no client-errors spike.
qa-lead: excluded customers OK. cu-771 occurrences unchanged in v2 sample (still failing there) but isolated to low-frequency path.
release-manager: given isolation and exclusions, proceed to 100% with final manual ack after one more hold.
infra-oncall: caution: we've disabled auto-unpin; if anything triggers quarantine, we may need manual intervention. watching.
diana: sending short release note to #customer-success explaining targeted exclusion and ETA for fix.
josh: one more ask: pin the model artifact to sha256:deadbeef to prevent auto-upgrades mid-rollout.
deploy-bot: model pinned for cohorts.
perf-bot: running extra regression job on pinned artifact. id=reg-20260401-11.
qa-lead: holdpoint reached. awaiting release-manager ack to proceed to 100%.
release-manager: ack to proceed to 100% for non-excluded cohorts. moving to 100% now.
deploy-bot: ramp -> 100% initiated for eligible cohorts; excluded customers remain on v1.
josh: monitoring. if parser errors >0.1% for any non-excluded customer, we will flip the flag back to previous state.
infra-oncall: p99 stable; client-errors at 0.07%. no quarantine triggered.
diana: tagging follow-up: HOTFIX-tt/ tokenizer-fix branch, owner @josh, ETA 4h. include regen tests for emoji-leading prompts.
qa-lead: will add regression case to CI to catch this going forward.
release-manager: final notes: release completed with surgical exclusion, model pinned, post-rollout health check in 2h. add a public line in release notes: "Partial cohort exclusion for enterprise customers due to tokenizer edge case; fix in progress."
perf-bot: reminder scheduled: perf snapshot in 2h.
diana: thanks team. closing thread."
